summary: Build practical global HR, mobility, workforce planning, and reporting skills in five days. Explore the course and enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Global workforce management helps HR practitioners coordinate people, policies, and decisions across distributed operations. It supports HR business partners, mobility managers, talent acquisition leaders, and people analytics specialists in creating consistent workforce plans and processes. Participants practise identifying skills gaps, designing cross-cultural team protocols, and assessing international assignment risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate people, policies, data, and decisions across international or geographically distributed operations. It suits intermediate practitioners who already handle HR responsibilities and need a structured approach to global workforce management.
modules: AI Governance and Global HR Action
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in HR operations, talent management, workforce planning, employee relations, mobility, HRIS administration, or people analytics. Familiarity with organizational policies and basic workforce metrics will help. No programming is required. Digital exercises use spreadsheet-based templates and may use Power BI demonstrations, so a laptop is recommended.
